body.en: George Gamow argued that the code must be a triplet, since 4³ = 64 combinations are needed to code 20 amino acids. Nirenberg, Ochoa (polynucleotide phosphorylase) and Har Gobind Khorana worked out the codons. Of 64 codons, 61 code for amino acids and 3 (UAA, UAG, UGA) are stop codons. The code is read without commas, is unambiguous (one codon, one amino acid) and degenerate (many amino acids have more than one codon), and is nearly universal. AUG codes for methionine and is also the initiator codon. Inserting or deleting one or two bases shifts the reading frame (frameshift mutation); three bases insert or delete one amino acid.
body.kn: ಜನ್ಯ ಸಂಕೇತ ತ್ರಿವಳಿ; 64 ಸಂಕೇತಗಳಲ್ಲಿ 61 ಅಮೈನೋ ಆಮ್ಲಗಳಿಗೆ, 3 ನಿಲುಗಡೆ ಸಂಕೇತಗಳು (UAA, UAG, UGA). ಸಂಕೇತ ನಿಸ್ಸಂದಿಗ್ಧ, ಅಪಭ್ರಷ್ಟ ಮತ್ತು ಬಹುತೇಕ ಸಾರ್ವತ್ರಿಕ. AUG ಮೆಥಿಯೋನಿನ್ ಮತ್ತು ಆರಂಭ ಸಂಕೇತ.

say.en: Why three letters? With four bases, one letter gives 4 codes and two letters 16, too few for 20 amino acids. Three letters give 64.
Of the 64 codons, 61 code for amino acids and three are stop codons. AUG codes for methionine and also starts translation.
The code is read without commas. Delete one letter and every word after it changes: a frameshift. Delete three and the frame is restored.
tRNA is the adapter: its anticodon pairs with the codon on mRNA, and its other end carries the matching amino acid.
In the ribosome the 23S rRNA forms the peptide bonds: a ribozyme. The ribosome moves codon by codon until a stop codon.

body.en: tRNA is the adapter: its anticodon loop pairs with the codon, and its other end carries the amino acid. It has a clover-leaf secondary structure and an inverted L shape in 3D. Amino acids are activated with ATP and linked to their tRNA: charging or aminoacylation. The ribosome's large subunit holds two sites for tRNAs, and in bacteria the 23S rRNA acts as the enzyme (ribozyme) that forms peptide bonds. The ribosome moves along mRNA from codon to codon from the start codon AUG to a stop codon, where a release factor ends *translation*. Untranslated regions (UTRs) at both ends help efficient translation.

heading.en: Genetic Code, Translation and the Lac Operon

tagline.en: How the triplet code was cracked and its features, mutations and the reading frame, tRNA as the adapter, the steps of translation, levels of gene regulation and the lac operon of E. coli.

myth.en: The repressor protein of the lac operon is made only when lactose is absent.

truth.en: The i gene makes the repressor all the time. Lactose does not stop its synthesis; it inactivates the repressor already made. Because the operon is 'off' without lactose, students think the repressor appears only then. The switch is the inducer–repressor binding, not the making of the repressor.

say.en: Code: triplet, 61 sense + 3 stop codons, unambiguous, degenerate, comma-less, nearly universal; AUG = Met + start.
1 or 2 base insertion/deletion = frameshift; 3 bases = one amino acid gained or lost.
tRNA: anticodon loop + acceptor end; clover-leaf (2-D), inverted L (3-D); no tRNA for stop codons.
Translation: charging, initiation (AUG), elongation, termination (release factor); 23S rRNA is a ribozyme.
Lac operon: i → repressor; z, y, a → β-galactosidase, permease, transacetylase; lactose is the inducer; negative regulation.

The switch is the inducer–repressor binding, not the making of the repressor.

say.en: Let us work this out together. A mature mRNA has a coding region of 900 nucleotides including the start and stop codons. How many amino acids are in the protein?
Number of codons equals 900 divided by 3 equals 300.
The stop codon does not code for an amino acid: 300 minus 1 equals 299.
So the answer is 299 amino acids.

narration.en: Recap. The code is triplet: 64 codons, 61 sense, 3 stop. AUG codes for methionine and starts translation. tRNA is the adapter; charging attaches amino acids using ATP. 23S rRNA is the ribozyme that forms peptide bonds in bacteria.
narration.kn: ಪುನರಾವರ್ತನೆ. ಸಂಕೇತ ತ್ರಿವಳಿ: 64, ಅವುಗಳಲ್ಲಿ 3 ನಿಲುಗಡೆ. AUG ಮೆಥಿಯೋನಿನ್ ಮತ್ತು ಆರಂಭ ಸಂಕೇತ. tRNA ಅಡಾಪ್ಟರ್; ಚಾರ್ಜಿಂಗ್‌ಗೆ ATP. 23S rRNA ಪೆಪ್ಟೈಡ್ ಬಂಧ ರಚಿಸುವ ರೈಬೋಜೈಮ್.
